cloud_contract: Cloud UI 4.4.0-cloud-ui.7 is a separately controlled deployment companion; no Cloud mutation is performed by this device publication.
controlled_parent: Exact published and installed FlightCore 4.4.0-rc.26 build 20260906.103720-d4afcf7, retained only as a failed-candidate recovery source. RC24 remains the last accepted parent.
home_marker: Camera-frame-correct projected H, continuous full-sphere edge mapping, fixed Air Link aircraft-frame behavior, SIYI earth/vehicle yaw-frame handling and fail-closed stale-data suppression.
hotfix_state: No mutable hotfix. RC27 is a new immutable candidate; RC26 is consumed and non-promotable.
lte_presentation: Local and Cloud UI 7 preserve ECI/eNodeB/sector/TAC history without MCC/MNC; public lookup remains restricted to complete identities and partial observations are never claimed as tower coordinates.
operator_workflow: Publish, independently verify, run the exact RC26 or RC24 read-only preflight, then use the FlightCore Software Update page.
public_bootstrap: Self-contained RC27 bootstrap; no companion shell helper is required.
registry_gate: Exact failed RC26 recovery, exact accepted RC24, retained exact historical routes and genuine fresh installation; modified or unknown sources fail closed.
rollback_integrity: Canonical release-tree snapshots and restores use one checksummed helper and fail closed on missing, altered or unverifiable recovery material.
simulation_safety: Disarmed-only browser state; armed/unknown/stale/disconnected state discards it, disarm does not reactivate it, and refresh/reconnect/reboot clear it; no flight-controller state is written.
